question: Which of the following figures made from 6 identical small squares cannot be folded into a cube?
solution: A figure containing a \(2\times2\) block cannot be folded into a cube (some faces would overlap). The other three are of types 3-3, 2-2-2, and 1-4-1, respectively, and are all nets of a cube.

reference.question: Which of the following figures made from 6 identical small squares cannot be folded into a cube?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Recognizing cube nets

A figure containing a \(2\times2\) block cannot be folded into a cube (some faces would overlap). The other three are of types 3-3, 2-2-2, and 1-4-1, respectively, and are all nets of a cube.
